recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, overlapping photo collage featuring various snapshots of urban lifestyle, luxury, and personal struggle, framed by a thick solid red border with a central horizontal title bar.
coreVisualRelationships: Overlapping rectangular images creating a chaotic but unified mosaic
A central horizontal red bar anchoring the composition
A thick outer red frame containing the internal complexity
High-contrast mix of indoor luxury and outdoor street scenes
coreInvariants: Central red title bar with white sans-serif text
Overlapping photo edges with varying angles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Decentralized; multiple subjects of equal scale distributed across the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central red horizontal bar containing the title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular movement following the tilted angles of the photos, eventually settling on the central red bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is intentionally crowded to convey a 'life story' narrative.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the framing elements against a varied palette of naturalistic and high-contrast photography.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard geometric forms used for maximum legibility against the busy background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-font impact; no secondary typefaces used to avoid clutter.
graphicDevices: Solid red rectangular background for text

candidateDirections.reason: Classic bold condensed sans-serif for high-impact titles.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dense collage of 30-40 overlapping photos showing urban life, luxury cars, jewelry, and street scenes. Tilt the photos at various angles (5-15 degrees). Surround the entire collage with a thick, solid red border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a solid red horizontal rectangle in the exact center. Inside this rectangle, typeset the title in a bold, white, all-caps geometric sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the red border solid and thick?
Are the photos overlapping without visible gaps?
Is the central text bar perfectly horizontal?
Is the font a clean, bold sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Number of photos in the collage
mustRedesign: Branded logos on clothing or cars
postGenerationChecks: Verify text is centered in the red bar
Confirm no generic stock watermarks are visible
Check that the red color is uniform across the border and bar
recipe.reuseFormula: Collage of [Subject Matter] + Overlapping Tilted Layout + Solid [Color] Border + Central [Color] Title Bar with [Font Style] Text
